title: 上海初印象：从机场到市中心
author: Wander Abroad

sentences.en: Good morning, I'm in Shanghai, and I'm really excited to be here.
sentences.zh: 早上好，我现在在上海，能来到这里真的很兴奋。

sentences.en: China has been on my bucket list for a very long time.
sentences.zh: 中国在我的愿望清单上已经很久了。

sentences.en: After getting off the plane, there was fingerprinting and immigration.
sentences.zh: 下飞机后进行了指纹采集和入境检查。

sentences.en: I could pass the ticket gate with an Alipay QR code.
sentences.zh: 我用支付宝的二维码就通过了检票口。

sentences.en: The airport is ridiculously big, with huge and easy-to-read guide signs.
sentences.zh: 机场大得离谱，指示牌巨大且一目了然。

sentences.en: I felt comfortable on the train, and the city looked amazing.
sentences.zh: 我在地铁上感觉很自在，城市看起来令人惊叹。

sentences.en: My hotel room was bigger than I expected, and there was a bathtub.
sentences.zh: 我的酒店房间比预期的大，还有浴缸。

sentences.en: I thought about ordering dinner delivery, but it kept giving errors.
sentences.zh: 我想点外卖，但它一直报错。

sentences.en: So I ended up calling a taxi to eat at some random place.
sentences.zh: 于是我最后叫了辆出租车去随便一家店吃饭。

sentences.en: It was really cold, only seven degrees outside.
sentences.zh: 外面真的很冷，只有七度。

sentences.en: Public transport here is convenient and easy to follow.
sentences.zh: 这里的公共交通很方便，也容易看懂。

sentences.en: People were very friendly and always ready to help.
sentences.zh: 人们非常友善，总是乐意帮忙。
